g.text: BankDash Accounts Overview Interaction & Animation Locators
Visual mapping of 5 key interactive account modules, charts, and transaction feeds
KPI Hover Lift + Rolling Currency Counters
Cards elevate with subtle lift, squircle icon hover spin & instant numerical count-up
TRIGGER: Initial page load / Mouse hover
Transaction Feed Hover Glide & Status Glow
Rows translate +5px with status badge highlight (Pending/Completed) & icon zoom
TRIGGER: Mouse hover on transaction rows
Card Holographic Glare & See All Flow
Card follows cursor with 3D perspective angle and dynamic glare gradient reflection
TRIGGER: Cursor movement over card
Dual Comparison Bars Spring-Up + Value Tooltips
Paired Sat-Fri bars rise with elastic spring timing, interactive glow & delta tooltips
TRIGGER: Chart render / Hovering paired bars
Invoice Card Elevation & Amount Reveal
Sent invoice items slide slightly right with quick-action invoice preview modal trigger
TRIGGER: Hovering invoice entries / Clicking invoice
KEY INTERACTIONS SUMMARY:
KPIs: Rolling Counter
Feed: Row Glide
Card: 3D Glare
Chart: Dual Bar Spring
Invoices: Slide & Preview
All interactions use GPU hardware-accelerated transforms & zero-layout-shift (CLS = 0.00) with accessible aria controls.
